issues.description: Candidates 1 and 2 are duplicate Foxj1/ciliated nodal cell pairs; both retained as include.
Candidates 15-26 were labelled species 'unknown' but the paper is entirely mouse; species corrected to mouse.

Candidates 27-32 were assigned to 'spinal cord interneurons', but the cited source (actual Extended Data Fig. 10d) describes markers of anterior/posterior origins and inhibitory/excitatory functions for neuronal subtypes in Fig. 4e, not markers specific to spinal cord interneurons; excluded for gene-cell mismatch.
Many formal marker genes appearing in Extended Data figures and Fig. 5g node labels were outside the candidate list and have been added as new_findings.
